ways.description: The five ways a side declares, each by an id its harness keys its table by: a resolver registered on a client's router and on a server's, a requester made on each, and a notification registered on a client's.

names.description: A procedure's name, declared at service 1, procedure 1, revision 1, and whether it is taken.

ids.description: A service id, a procedure id and a revision, declared under the name echo or the one given, and whether they are taken.

folds.description: Two names, and whether they are one by spec 16.6.

refused.description: The first reason of spec 16.10 that applies, derived and held by the regeneration alone; absent, the declaration is taken.

procedureName.description: The procedure's name declared, any string.

serviceId.description: The service id declared, any JSON value, as a value read from JSON may be.

procedureId.description: The procedure id declared, any JSON value, as a value read from JSON may be.

serviceRevision.description: The service's revision declared, any JSON value, as a value read from JSON may be.

procedureName.description: The procedure's name declared, where it is not echo.

one.description: Whether the two are one name: equal once each ASCII upper-case letter is read as its lower-case one, and nothing else changed.
